mini_task_spec:
Using the **fan-in** capability of a dependency-graph tool, find all non-test TypeScript source files inside `test-repo/packages/core` that directly import from `metadata-scanner` (i.e., contain an `import` statement referencing `metadata-scanner`). Exclude any file whose path contains `/test/`. Return the results as a sorted list of relative file paths (relative to the repository root, i.e., prefixed with `test-repo/`), one per line, in alphabetical order.

Expected answer format: a list of file paths, one per line, sorted alphabetically, e.g.:
```
test-repo/packages/core/discovery/discovery-module.ts
test-repo/packages/core/middleware/routes-mapper.ts
...
```
